items.description: The Dynamic Insights platform by Zrillo pulls data from small business apps to give accountants, advisors, franchises and small business owners to give them a complete picture of a business via dashboards with over 60 widgets.

Google Analytics Core Reporting API can build customized dashboards to show Google Analytics Data, automate reporting assignments, and integrate Google Analytics information. A reference guide shows steps to facilitate development. Elements include requests with query parameters, responses with formats, and samples with results. Google Helpouts are available to assist with questions. Camera, mic, and speakers should function efficiently to interact with an expert.

The Open Movie Database API by Brian Fritz is an open database that sources movie information from other movie sites such as IMBD, Rotten Tomatoes, and Wikipedia. Users can access The Open Movie Database API uses REST or JavaScript to allow users to search for a movie title, a valid IMDB ID, year of a movie, or a plot. The service is free to use.
One Stop Cottage, the Holiday Cottage Search Engine, is a very fast way to find your UK holiday cottage. It quickly searches over 40,000 cottages from 35 companies.
This API creates a unique random pixel image with a retro look for a given seed value. These values can be name, email, profile id and more.
Powerfully motivating facts, tips and encouragement to help you quit smoking. Delivered to you fresh daily by voice, email and text.
Smart Recorder is an audio recording app for the iPhone, and this mashup allows users to save their recordings to their Box.net accounts from within Smart Recorder.
A mashup of Google Maps, Weather.com and MSN that can help you search the world quickly.

With the AYLIEN Text Analysis API, web users can analyze text from social media using Google Spreadsheet. The way this add-on works is by copying and pasting text from the social media channel to be analyzed. One of the main benefits of this tool is the evaluation of sentiment according to positive, negative, or neutral stream comments. Users can also summarize text, detect language, and classify documents. To use Text Analysis, users need to sign up to Google to access, run, and test the form.
A personalized information portal from Mauritius Island which integrates Flickr and del.icio.us.

Calculate your geoposition by address and create geotags, geo-metatags and kml files for your website, weblog or photo. Use a drag-and-drop marker on the result map to optimize your position. NEW: Reverse lookup - Enter a geocoded URL, see its location.
